div.p: Located between King and William streets, Ramsay Lane extends from Little Bourke to Bourke streets. The laneway was formed pre-1915 and was possibly named after the Reverend A.M. Ramsay of the local United Presbyterian Church, who arrived in the colony of Victoria in the 1840s.
